title: Add response metadata
summary: FastAPI: Add response metadata. Inspect Cache-Control with curl -i.
introduction: The Response input lets a function set headers. Open GET /note.

blocks.text: Install fastapi and uvicorn with python -m pip install fastapi uvicorn. Save one example as app.py and run uvicorn app:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000. Use the stated route on that address.

blocks.title: Add response metadata

blocks.text: The injected response object receives the header. The returned dictionary supplies the body.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: A header changes metadata, not the JSON field values.
